focus: Default channel_message_templates and add_default_apply_response_template — verify subject is included in defaults

tests.name: Organization.default_channel_message_templates includes subject
tests.detail: All 3 default templates (Thank you for applying, Scheduling, Rejection) include subject: '{{JobTitle}} at {{OrganizationName}}'. Count is exactly 3. Names match expected values.

tests.name: Cypress-seeded org channel_message_templates subject check
tests.detail: The seeded Acme Inc. org has 3 channel_message_templates but all have subject=nil. This is EXPECTED because the Cypress server runs from the main checkout (/Users/jessica/wrk/wrk-corp/inflow-ats) which does NOT have the subject feature code — Organization.default_channel_message_templates on the main checkout does not include the subject key. This is a QA infrastructure limitation, not a bug in the feature.

tests.name: New Organization created via worktree code gets templates with subject
tests.detail: Created a new Organization directly via rails runner in the worktree. The after_create callback fired add_default_channel_message_templates, which correctly populated all 3 templates with subject: '{{JobTitle}} at {{OrganizationName}}'. This confirms the feature code is correct.

tests.name: Job.add_default_apply_response_template sets apply_response_template_subject
tests.detail: Both the existing seeded job and a newly-created job have apply_response_template_subject set to '{{JobTitle}} at {{OrganizationName}}'. The add_default_apply_response_template callback uses update_columns to set both apply_response_template (body) and apply_response_template_subject. Confirmed working on both seeded and freshly-created jobs.

findings.title: Cypress seed server runs from main checkout, not worktree — seeded data lacks feature-branch fields
findings.detail: The qa-config.yml points source_repo at /Users/jessica/wrk/wrk-corp/inflow-ats (the main checkout). The qa-harness starts the Cypress server from this path. The main checkout's Organization.default_channel_message_templates does NOT include subject keys. So Cypress-seeded organizations get channel_message_templates with subject=nil. The worktree code at /Users/jessica/wrk/wrk-corp/inflow-ats.messaging-improvements correctly includes subject in all 3 defaults. To test seeded data with feature-branch code, the qa-harness server should run from the worktree, or the test should create data directly via rails runner in the worktree.
findings.recommendation: For QA runs testing feature-branch code, start the Cypress server from the worktree, or accept that seeded data reflects the base branch and test creation behavior via rails runner instead.

findings.title: add_default_apply_response_template uses update_columns (skips callbacks/validations)
findings.detail: Job#add_default_apply_response_template uses update_columns to set apply_response_template and apply_response_template_subject. This is appropriate for an after_create callback since the record is already saved and we just want to set defaults without triggering additional callbacks. No issue found.

summary: All feature code for default channel_message_templates and add_default_apply_response_template is correctly implemented. Organization.default_channel_message_templates includes subject: '{{JobTitle}} at {{OrganizationName}}' in all 3 templates. The after_create callback add_default_channel_message_templates correctly persists these templates with subject populated. Job#add_default_apply_response_template correctly sets apply_response_template_subject to '{{JobTitle}} at {{OrganizationName}}' via update_columns. One infrastructure note: Cypress-seeded data has nil subjects because the Cypress server runs from the main checkout which lacks the feature code — this is expected and not a bug.
